mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT mp.id, mp.name, mp.parent_id AS parentId, mp.link_url AS linkUrl, mp.description, mp.image_path AS imagePath, mp.icon, mp.sort_order AS sortOrder, mp.status, 'menu' AS type FROM menu_page mp WHERE mp.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(wp.menu_ids, ',', numbers.n), ',', -1) AS UNSIGNED) AS menu_id FROM workposition wp CROSS JOIN ( SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20 ) numbers WHERE wp.id = #{positionId} AND wp.menu_ids IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(wp.menu_ids) > 0 AND numbers.n <= (LENGTH(wp.menu_ids) - LENGTH(REPLACE(wp.menu_ids, ',', '')) + 1) AND CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(wp.menu_ids, ',', numbers.n), ',', -1) AS UNSIGNED) > 0 ) AND mp.status = 1 AND mp.delflag = 0 ORDER BY mp.parent_id, mp.sort_order

SELECT mf.id, mf.perm_code AS code, mf.perm_name AS name, mf.perm_type AS type, mf.sort_order AS sortOrder, mf.icon, mf.description FROM menu_func mf WHERE mf.menu_page_id = #{menuId} ORDER BY mf.sort_order

SELECT mp.id, mp.name, mp.parent_id AS parentId, mp.link_url AS linkUrl, mp.description, mp.image_path AS imagePath, mp.icon, mp.sort_order AS sortOrder, mp.status FROM menu_page mp WHERE mp.status = 1 AND mp.delflag = 0 ORDER BY mp.parent_id, mp.sort_order

SELECT mp.id, mp.name, mp.parent_id AS parentId, mp.link_url AS linkUrl, mp.description, mp.image_path AS imagePath, mp.icon, mp.sort_order AS sortOrder, mp.status FROM menu_page mp WHERE mp.id = #{id} AND mp.status = 1 AND mp.delflag = 0
